iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::fingerprint
       Returns fingerprint data, only in context of ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN event.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::fingerprint

DESCRIPTION
       Returns fingerprint data collected on client side.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns fingerprint data collected on client side.

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN {
	    log local0. "Client fingerprint: [ANTIFRAUD::fingerprint]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
